d:
The Lenovo Y700 Gen 5 is here — and after using every generation since the original, this might be the most refined compact Android tablet yet. With a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, a larger vapor chamber for incredible sustained performance, a 165Hz display, and a bigger 9000mAh battery, Lenovo has clearly pushed things forward.
But it’s not perfect. There’s still no OLED, no cellular option, and this time… a significant price jump.
